title: Score-based Generative Modeling Secretly Minimizes the Wasserstein Distance
tldr_zh: W2(数据,生成)≤C√J_SM+I(T)W2(p_T,q_T)：score matching损失平方根上界控制W2，证明用连续性方程求W2时间导数
tldr_en: W2(data, generated) <= C sqrt(J_SM) + I(T) W2(p_T,q_T): the score-matching loss upper-bounds the Wasserstein distance via time-derivatives of W2 along continuity equations.
key_numbers: Corollary 1: W2(p0,q0) <= sqrt(2 (int g^2 I^2 dt) J_SM) + I(T) W2(pT,qT), I(t)=exp(int (L_f + L_s g^2)) (Eq. 16)
Theorem 2: J_SM <= J_DSM when Var[E[grad log p_0t | x0]] = 0 (DDPM satisfies) (Eq. 21-22)

2D experiments (T=10 DDPM, sigmoid beta 1e-5..1e-2): log-log theoretical line upper-bounds empirical W2 on all 3 datasets (Figure 2); L_s(t) -> -1 and offset decays ~exponentially for T >= 100 (Figure 4)
